text.title: FreshDrop mobile team: delivery board for the buyer app, September 2026
text.x2: Developer has capacity, WIP below limit
text.x5: Checked on staging, no open bugs
text.bounds: Started when a card leaves Ready; finished in Done; lead time counted from creation
text.lanes: Expedite lane for production bugs, one card at a time; features and QA bugs in standard lanes
text.blocked: Red flag with reason and owner; the team lead removes it by the next stand-up
text.replenish: Every Monday product adds up to 10 cards to Backlog; the team pulls 8 into Ready
text.metrics: WIP 14 on average; throughput 9 cards a week; median cycle time 3.1 days; oldest card 6 days (checked daily)
text.sle: 85% of cards done in 5 days or faster; July: 78%
text.decision: Code review is the bottleneck: cards wait 1.8 days. From 1 October: pair review for cards over 3 files; check the wait time in 2 weeks
